premise: Raccoon finds a dewdrop shining like treasure and tries to carry it home, but it keeps slipping away; Bird shows them the sunshine inside it belongs to everyone.
inspiration: The Dog and His Reflection (Aesop), turned: not greed but wonder, and the treasure is not lost, only shared.
lesson: Some treasures can only be shared, not kept.

en-US.title: Raccoon's Shiny Treasure
en-US.text: Early morning. Raccoon stopped in the grass. {raccoon:pulse} Ooh. On a blade of grass sat a dewdrop, round as a pearl, and inside it, {raccoon:sparkle} a tiny sun was shining. Treasure! Raccoon reached out two careful paws. Got it! The dewdrop wobbled, {raccoon:wobble} and slid, and plip, was gone. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} watched from a leaf. Try a leaf, she said. Raccoon scooped a dewdrop onto a leaf, and tipped it, and the sun inside went out. It's just water now, said Raccoon, sadly. Bird landed beside them. {bird:hop x2} The shine isn't in the drop, said Bird. Look up. Raccoon looked up. The sun was climbing over the trees, and every dewdrop in the meadow, {ladybug:sparkle} {bird:sparkle} {raccoon:sparkle} lit up at once. Oh, breathed Raccoon. That's a lot of treasure. All of it yours, said Bird. And all of it everyone's.

es-ES.title: El tesoro brillante de Mapache
es-ES.text: Era temprano. Mapache se paró entre la hierba. {raccoon:pulse} Ooh. En una brizna de hierba había una gota de rocío, redonda como una perla, y dentro {raccoon:sparkle} brillaba un sol chiquitito. ¡Un tesoro! Mapache estiró las dos manos con cuidado. ¡Ya es mía! La gota tembló, {raccoon:wobble} resbaló y, plic, se fue. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} miraba desde una hoja. Prueba con una hoja, dijo. Mapache recogió una gota en una hoja, la inclinó, y el sol de dentro se apagó. Ahora es solo agua, dijo Mapache, triste. Pájaro se posó a su lado. {bird:hop x2} El brillo no está en la gota, dijo Pájaro. Mira arriba. Mapache miró. El sol subía por encima de los árboles, y todas las gotas del prado, {ladybug:sparkle} {bird:sparkle} {raccoon:sparkle} se encendieron a la vez. Oh, suspiró Mapache. Eso es muchísimo tesoro. Todo tuyo, dijo Pájaro. Y de todos.
